BiblicalUsage: Tirhanah is named once, in a genealogy. Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber and Tirhanah, and the name sits in the middle of Caleb's sprawling family record.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a one-line name matters: the Bible counts the children of concubines alongside the children of wives, and nobody in Caleb's house is left unnamed.
